items.title: 一買就是20年！川普稱台灣包下阿拉斯加LNG三成產量 並加碼投資44億美元
items.title_en: One Purchase for 20 Years! Trump Says Taiwan Will Secure 30% of Alaska LNG Output and Add $4.4 Billion Investment
paras: 美國總統川普表示，台灣已同意在未來20年內，採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣（LNG）管線計畫30%的天然氣產量，並在期中選舉前大力宣傳這項計畫。
川普還表示，台灣將額外投資44億美元，協助該計畫完工。他周二(13日)在阿拉斯加州的競選活動中讚揚這些承諾，並宣稱雖然外界對管道能否建成仍存疑，但此舉已「確保了計畫的成功」。
台灣方面尚未立即證實川普的說法。
川普本月初曾表示，南韓將投資540億美元建設阿拉斯加LNG合資計畫，用於輸送阿拉斯加北坡（North Slope）的天然氣並將其液化出口。然而，南韓方面表示，僅會在該計畫具備商業可行性的前提下才會推進。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of the natural‑gas output from the Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline project over the next 20 years, and he will heavily promote the plan before the mid‑term elections.

Trump also said Taiwan will invest an additional $4.4 billion to help complete the project. He praised the commitments during a campaign event in Alaska on Tuesday the 13th, claiming that, although doubts remain about whether the pipeline can be built, the move has "guaranteed the project's success."
Taiwan has not immediately confirmed Trump's statements.

Earlier this month, Trump claimed South Korea would invest $54 billion in a joint Alaska LNG venture to transport natural gas from the North Slope and liquefy it for export. South Korean officials, however, said they would only proceed if the project proved commercially viable.

items.title: 〈蘋果發布會分析〉三款智慧家庭主機齊漲價 HomeView、Apple TV 4K能否靠Siri AI打開市場?
items.title_en: Apple Event Analysis: Three Smart Home Hubs Raise Prices – Can HomeView and Apple TV 4K Open the Market with Siri AI?
paras: 蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 週二(13日)在紐約舉行媒體活動，一次推出首款智慧家庭顯示器HomeView、第4代Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 2，以及與LG電子 (LG Electronics) (066570-KR)、施耐德電機 (Schneider Electric) (SU-FR)共同設計的Apple Home Collection智慧家庭配件。
這波新品涵蓋顯示器、影音串流、智慧喇叭與家庭安全設備，並以新版Siri AI、跨裝置整合及隱私保護為主要賣點。不過，三款主機同步提高售價，AI功能又採取分階段上線，部分配件更要等到12月甚至2027年初才會到貨，使這場發表會的焦點不只是產品線擴張，也包括蘋果能否說服消費者為更高價格與生態系整合付費。

【四條產品線，三個上市時點】

根據蘋果新聞稿及各媒體整理，HomePod mini 2定價149美元，預計10月30日開賣；HomeView定價299美元，桌上型與壁掛型同價，預計11月13日起在美國、英國、澳洲、加拿大、紐西蘭、印度、新加坡與南非上市，新加坡將於10月15日開放預購。第4代Apple TV 4K同樣定價299美元，預計11月13日上市，並在美國及另外29個國家和地區開放預購。
Apple Home Collection則要到12月才開始供貨，部分配件延至2027年初。《PopSci》指出，HomeView壁掛版所需的乙太網路供電 (PoE) 電源座也要到2027年初才會推出。
這代表消費者必須分階段才能建立較完整的蘋果智慧家庭系統。HomePod mini 2雖然會率先開賣，但要搭配HomeView、Apple TV 4K及門鈴、門鎖等配件，至少要等到11月中旬以後，部分設備甚至得等到明年。蘋果將Home Collection放在自家零售通路銷售，並在美國提供ADT付費到府安裝服務，希望降低一般家庭安裝攝影機與門鎖的門檻。

【價格帶：三款主機都往上走】

價格是這次發表會最受關注的焦點之一。《PopSci》整理，Apple TV 4K於2022年推出時的售價為129美元，蘋果今年6月因記憶體晶片短缺將起價調高至199美元，新一代產品進一步定價299美元，比6月調漲後的價格高出約50%。《Engadget》也指出，新款Apple TV 4K比前代貴100美元。

《PopSci》並指出，新款Apple TV 4K的價格約為Google TV Streamer的兩倍。Google TV Streamer於8月31日調漲後的價格為149.99美元。新款Apple TV 4K僅提供128GB一種容量，標配Wi-Fi 7、Gigabit乙太網路與Thread，讓每台裝置都能作為完整的智慧家庭中樞。過去較便宜的Apple TV機型並未同時具備乙太網路與Thread功能，因此蘋果試圖以更完整的連線規格支撐價格上調。
HomePod mini 2的漲幅相對較小，但價格同樣提高。《PopSci》指出，新款149美元的定價比原版2020年上市時的99美元高出50美元，也比蘋果今年6月調漲後的價格多20美元。《TechRadar》估算，若以四顆HomePod mini 2搭配新款Apple TV 4K組成環繞音響系統，整套價格將達895美元。
HomeView定價299美元，則明顯高於主要競爭產品。根據《路透社》報導，亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) Echo Show 8售價為199.99美元，Google Nest Hub售價為99.99美元。蘋果必須證明，HomeView在家庭控制、個人化介面、Siri AI與隱私保護方面的整合價值，足以支撐與競爭對手之間的價差。
Apple Home Collection的價格區間則從39.95美元的溫度感測器，到399.95美元的LG泛光燈攝影機。這批產品涵蓋攝影機、門鈴、門鎖、恆溫器與其他家庭配件，讓蘋果得以擴展從室內控制到居家安全的產品範圍。不過，配件尚未全面到貨，消費者短期內仍無法一次建立完整的蘋果智慧家庭系統。
《WIRED》也提到，蘋果此次沒有推出2023年款HomePod 2的接班產品，並認為HomeView本身就是一款結合螢幕與喇叭功能的裝置，可能與傳統智慧喇叭形成產品定位重疊。《TechRadar》則指出，第2代HomePod不會獲得Siri AI更新，蘋果尚未說明原因。這使蘋果既有智慧家庭產品的定位及更新政策，也成為消費者評估升級時需要考量的因素。

【Siri AI：賣點是同一個，上線進度卻不一樣】

三款主機都以Siri AI為主要賣點，但功能取得時間與支援方式並不相同。HomeView從上市時便內建Siri AI；蘋果表示，第2代以後的Apple TV 4K將以測試版 (beta) 提供相關功能，初期支援美國、澳洲、加拿大、印度、紐西蘭、新加坡、南非與英國的英文使用環境。HomePod mini 2則要等到未來的軟體更新才能取得Siri AI，蘋果尚未公布確切日期。
蘋果也表示，由於Siri AI目前尚無法在歐盟提供，HomeView初期不會在歐盟上市，公司正與歐盟方面尋求解決方案。這代表即使硬體已準備就緒，AI服務的市場覆蓋範圍仍可能受到法規與軟體部署進度影響。

根據《Fortune》報導，新版Siri將運用Google (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US)的Gemini技術，提升理解螢幕內容、掌握個人情境及採取相應行動的能力。Moor Insights & Strategy分析師Anshel Sag向《Fortune》表示，這是蘋果「重啟整個居家策略」的第一階段。他指出，過去Siri遇到無法處理的問題時，往往需要轉交ChatGPT等其他服務，如今新版Siri已能直接回答更多問題。
不過，Sag也認為，一般消費者似乎還不清楚Siri已經升級，蘋果必須加強市場溝通，讓使用者了解新功能與過去有何不同。對蘋果而言，AI模型能力提升只是第一步，如何讓消費者實際感受到功能改善，才是能否帶動新一輪硬體需求的關鍵。

【iPhone綁定：體驗的起點也是門檻】

個人化是這批產品的另一項共同設計，但也帶出生態系綁定的問題。蘋果在新聞稿註腳中說明，若要使用Siri AI的個人情境功能，家庭擁有者必須具備支援Apple Intelligence的iPhone或iPad。《The Verge》則指出，HomeView的完整使用體驗可能要求家中每位使用者都使用搭載最新系統的iPhone，這對iOS與Android並存的家庭，或仍使用舊款iPhone的消費者，可能形成門檻。

《WIRED》報導指出，HomeView的臉部辨識與個人化切換功能，需要使用者的iPhone連接相同Wi-Fi網路，並在近期解鎖。該媒體也提到，若要發揮完整功能，使用者可能需要iPhone 15 Pro或更新機種，而且無法用iPad完成所有設定。《TechRadar》則表示，初次設定需要iPhone或iPad。各家媒體對個別設定條件的描述略有差異，但都指向同一件事，即蘋果智慧家庭裝置要發揮完整功能，仍高度依賴iPhone及其軟體環境。
這種策略具有兩面性。對已經擁有iPhone、Apple TV、HomePod及其他蘋果產品的家庭而言，跨裝置整合可以降低操作成本，讓個人化資訊與家庭控制更加便利；但對使用Android手機、混用不同品牌智慧家庭設備，或不願更新手機的消費者而言，額外的相容條件可能降低購買意願。蘋果若希望智慧家庭成為更大的成長來源，就必須在維持生態系優勢與降低使用門檻之間取得平衡。

配件方面，蘋果選擇不完全自行製造，而是與LG電子及施耐德電機合作推出Apple Home Collection。《Fortune》引述Counterpoint Research研究總監Mohit Agrawal的書面分析指出，蘋果不像亞馬遜收購Ring、Google收購Nest那樣直接買下相關品牌，而是與LG及施耐德合作，快速補齊從大門安全到恆溫器的產品線，同時透過Siri與Home app掌握使用體驗。
CCS Insight共同創辦人Ben Wood則向《路透社》表示，蘋果通常偏好掌控自家硬體，但此次與合作夥伴的協作看來相當深入，目的在確保產品設計、工程與使用體驗符合蘋果的要求。這批配件使用近場通訊 (NFC)，消費者將iPhone靠近裝置即可設定，不必另外建立LG或施耐德帳號。這種方式有助降低跨品牌設定的複雜度，但產品供應、售後服務與功能更新仍需仰賴合作夥伴。

【市場時機與財務壓力】

IDC消費裝置研究總監Jitesh Ubrani向《WIRED》表示，亞馬遜與Google都已將AI整合至智慧家庭平台，分別推進Alexa+與Gemini相關功能，但推出速度同樣緩慢。因此，蘋果此時將Siri AI帶進家庭市場，競爭對手並沒有明顯領先到難以追趕。
Counterpoint Research的Agrawal則認為，市場上大量智慧喇叭與家庭中樞仍屬價格較低、無法在裝置端執行AI的產品，這些設備已逐漸進入可能被新一代產品取代的階段。隨著亞馬遜、Google與蘋果陸續更新硬體，消費者換機需求可能增加，但換機機會能否轉化為實際銷售，仍取決於新功能是否足夠有用，以及消費者能否接受更高價格。
蘋果加速智慧家庭布局，也與部門營收表現有關。根據《Fortune》報導，蘋果穿戴式裝置、家居與配件部門2025財年營收下滑4%，約為357億美元。《CNBC》指出，截至6月的最近一季，該部門營收為78.8億美元，約占蘋果總營收的7%，其中包含Apple TV與HomePod等產品。《Fortune》另提到，蘋果7月公布的第4財季營收預測低於市場預期。
這波發表會也是蘋果執行長特納斯 (John Ternus) 9月接替庫克 (Tim Cook) 後，繼折疊手機iPhone Duo之後的另一波新品。對蘋果而言，智慧家庭不僅是擴充產品線，也可能成為延伸iPhone生態系、增加使用者接觸品牌頻率的入口。然而，三款主機同步漲價、AI功能尚未全面到位、配件供貨時間分散，都可能使消費者延後升級。
另一方面，PP Foresight分析師Paolo Pescatore向《路透社》表示，蘋果必須證明AI能帶來超越基本語音指令的實質好處，而可靠度、信任與易用性才是消費者是否接受的關鍵。若新版Siri無法穩定理解需求，或不能有效整合不同家庭設備，即使搭載更先進的模型，也未必足以支撐更高的產品價格。

【後續觀察】

整體而言，蘋果這次透過HomeView、第4代Apple TV 4K、HomePod mini 2及Apple Home Collection，試圖建立涵蓋顯示器、影音串流、智慧喇叭與第三方配件的完整智慧家庭產品組合，並以新版Siri AI作為串連不同裝置的核心。不過，產品全面漲價、AI功能分批上線、配件供貨延後，以及對iPhone的依賴，都可能影響消費者採用速度。

接下來有三個關鍵變數值得觀察。第一，三款主機同步漲價後，消費者是否願意為更高的整合度付費，尤其HomeView定價299美元，明顯高於部分競爭產品。第二，Siri AI在Apple TV 4K上仍以測試版推出，HomePod mini 2則尚未取得相關功能，實際體驗何時全面到位，將影響蘋果的市場說服力。第三，HomeView對iPhone及特定系統條件的依賴，會不會限制潛在客群，也讓歐盟等尚未開賣的市場延後導入。
若新版Siri能穩定處理更複雜的需求，HomeView也能順暢整合門鎖、攝影機、影音設備與家庭行事曆，較高的價格或許能由便利性與隱私優勢支撐。反之，如果消費者仍主要將這些裝置視為播放影音、控制燈光與執行基本語音指令的工具，那麼價格上調就可能成為市場擴張的障礙。蘋果智慧家庭能否真正成軍，最終仍要由11月13日首批產品上市、12月配件到貨後的實際體驗與消費者支付意願來驗證。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) held a media event in New York on Tuesday (the 13th), unveiling its first smart home display HomeView, the 4th‑generation Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the Apple Home Collection of smart‑home accessories co‑designed with LG Electronics (066570-KR) and Schneider Electric (SU-FR).

The new lineup covers a display, streaming device, smart speaker and home‑security gear, with the updated Siri AI, cross‑device integration and privacy protection as its main selling points. However, all three hubs see price hikes, AI features roll out in stages, and some accessories won’t arrive until December or even early 2027, making the event’s focus not just product expansion but also whether Apple can convince consumers to pay more for tighter ecosystem integration.

Four product lines, three launch dates. According to Apple’s press release and media reports, the HomePod mini 2 is priced at $149 and slated to launch on October 30; HomeView is priced at $299 (same price for tabletop and wall‑mounted versions) and will be available from November 13 in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, India, Singapore and South Africa, with pre‑orders opening in Singapore on October 15. The 4th‑gen Apple TV 4K is also priced at $299 and is expected to ship on November 13, with pre‑orders in the US and 29 other markets.

Apple Home Collection won’t ship until December, with some accessories delayed until early 2027. PopSci notes that the PoE power adapter required for the wall‑mounted HomeView won’t be released until early 2027.

This means consumers must build a complete Apple smart‑home system in phases. Although the HomePod mini 2 launches first, a full setup with HomeView, Apple TV 4K and doorbell, lock and other accessories won’t be possible until mid‑November at the earliest, and some devices won’t arrive until next year. Apple will sell the Home Collection through its own retail channels and offer paid ADT installation in the US to lower the barrier for installing cameras and locks in typical homes.

Price is one of the most watched aspects of the event. PopSci compiled that the Apple TV 4K launched in 2022 at $129; Apple raised the base price to $199 in June 2023 due to a memory‑chip shortage, and the new model is set at $299—about $50 more than the June price. Engadget also points out the new Apple TV 4K is $100 pricier than its predecessor.

PopSci adds that the new Apple TV 4K costs roughly twice as much as the Google TV Streamer, which after its August 31 price hike sits at $149.99. The new Apple TV 4K comes only in a 128 GB configuration, with standard Wi‑Fi 7, Gigabit Ethernet and Thread, allowing each unit to serve as a full smart‑home hub. Earlier, cheaper Apple TV models lacked both Ethernet and Thread, so Apple is using a more complete connectivity spec to justify the price increase.

The HomePod mini 2’s price jump is modest but still an increase. PopSci notes the $149 price is $50 higher than the original 2020 launch price of $99 and $20 above the price Apple set after its June hike. TechRadar estimates that a surround‑sound system built from four HomePod mini 2 units plus a new Apple TV 4K would cost $895 in total.

HomeView’s $299 price is clearly above its main competitors. Reuters reports Amazon’s Echo Show 8 sells for $199.99 and Google’s Nest Hub for $99.99. Apple must prove that HomeView’s integration of home control, personalized UI, Siri AI and privacy protection justifies the premium over rivals.

Apple Home Collection prices range from $39.95 for a temperature sensor to $399.95 for an LG floodlight camera. The line includes cameras, doorbells, locks, thermostats and other accessories, expanding Apple’s reach from indoor control to home security. However, because the accessories are not yet fully in stock, consumers cannot immediately build a complete Apple smart‑home system.

WIRED notes that Apple did not launch a successor to the 2023 HomePod 2, and suggests that HomeView, which combines a screen and speaker, may overlap with the traditional smart speaker segment. TechRadar points out that the 2nd‑gen HomePod will not receive the Siri AI update, with Apple yet to explain why. This adds another factor for consumers to consider when evaluating upgrades.

All three hubs tout Siri AI as the main selling point, but the rollout timing and support differ. HomeView ships with Siri AI built‑in; Apple says post‑launch Apple TV 4K (2nd‑gen onward) will receive Siri AI in beta, initially supporting English in the US, Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa and the UK. HomePod mini 2 will get Siri AI via a future software update, with no date announced yet.

Apple also said that because Siri AI cannot yet be offered in the EU, HomeView will not launch there initially, and the company is working with EU regulators on a solution. This means that even if the hardware is ready, AI service coverage may still be limited by regulations and software deployment schedules.

Fortune reports the new Siri will use Google’s (Alphabet) Gemini technology to improve its ability to understand screen content, grasp personal context and take appropriate actions. Moor Insights & Strategy analyst Anshel Sag told Fortune this is the first phase of Apple’s “reboot of the whole home strategy.” He noted that previously Siri often had to hand off to services like ChatGPT, whereas the new version can answer more queries directly.

Sag also believes most consumers are still unaware that Siri has been upgraded, and Apple needs to improve its marketing to explain how the new features differ from the old. For Apple, boosting AI model capability is only the first step; convincing users that the improvements are tangible will determine whether a new wave of hardware demand follows.

Personalization is another common design theme, but it also creates ecosystem lock‑in. Apple’s press release footnote says that to use Siri AI’s personal‑context features, the household head must own an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence. The Verge adds that a full HomeView experience may require every household member to use a latest‑generation iPhone, which could be a barrier for families that mix iOS and Android devices or still use older iPhones.

WIRED reports that HomeView’s facial recognition and personalized switching require the user’s iPhone to be on the same Wi‑Fi network and unlocked recently. The media also notes that full functionality may need an iPhone 15 Pro or newer, and cannot be set up entirely with an iPad. TechRadar says initial setup requires an iPhone or iPad. While the exact requirements differ slightly across outlets, they all point to the same conclusion: Apple’s smart‑home devices still heavily depend on an iPhone and its software ecosystem to unlock their full potential.

This strategy has two sides. For households already owning iPhones, Apple TV, HomePod and other Apple gear, cross‑device integration lowers operational friction and makes personalized info and home control more convenient. For Android users, mixed‑brand smart‑home setups, or consumers reluctant to upgrade their phones, the extra compatibility conditions may dampen purchase intent. If Apple wants smart‑home to become a larger growth engine, it must balance ecosystem advantage with lowering the entry barrier.

For accessories, Apple chose not to produce everything in‑house but partnered with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric for the Apple Home Collection. Fortune quoted Counterpoint Research’s Mohit Agrawal, who said Apple is not buying brands like Amazon did with Ring or Google with Nest; instead it is collaborating with LG and Schneider to quickly fill product gaps from door security to thermostats while leveraging Siri and the Home app for the user experience.

CCS Insight co‑founder Ben Wood told Reuters that Apple usually prefers to control its own hardware, but this partnership appears deep, aiming to ensure design, engineering and user experience meet Apple’s standards. The accessories use NFC, so users can simply tap an iPhone to the device to set it up without creating separate LG or Schneider accounts. This simplifies cross‑brand setup, though supply, after‑sales service and feature updates still depend on the partners.

IDC’s consumer‑device research director Jitesh Ubrani told WIRED that Amazon and Google have already integrated AI into their smart‑home platforms—Alexa+ and Gemini‑related features—though rollout speed is similarly gradual. Therefore, Apple’s timing in bringing Siri AI to the home market does not face a clear lead from competitors that would be impossible to catch up to.

Counterpoint’s Agrawal believes the market is still dominated by low‑priced smart speakers and hubs that cannot run AI locally, and these devices are entering a phase where they may be displaced by the next generation of products. As Amazon, Google and Apple update their hardware, consumer upgrade cycles could rise, but whether that translates into sales will depend on the usefulness of new features and consumer willingness to pay higher prices.

Apple’s accelerated smart‑home push also ties to its segment revenue performance. Fortune reports that Apple’s wearables, home and accessories segment saw a 4% revenue decline in FY 2025, to about $35.7 billion. CNBC noted that in the most recent quarter ending June, the segment generated $7.88 billion, roughly 7% of Apple’s total revenue, including Apple TV and HomePod products. Fortune also mentioned that Apple’s FY 4 quarter revenue forecast announced in July fell short of market expectations.

The event is also the first major product rollout since CEO John Ternus took over from Tim Cook in September, following the foldable iPhone Duo. For Apple, smart‑home is not just a product‑line expansion but also a way to extend the iPhone ecosystem and increase brand touchpoints. However, simultaneous price hikes for the three hubs, incomplete AI rollout and staggered accessory availability could delay consumer upgrades.

PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore told Reuters that Apple must prove Siri AI delivers benefits beyond basic voice commands, and that reliability, trust and ease‑of‑use will determine consumer acceptance. If the new Siri cannot consistently understand requests or effectively integrate disparate home devices, even a more advanced model may not justify the higher prices.

In summary, Apple is using HomeView, the 4th‑gen Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 and the Apple Home Collection to assemble a full smart‑home portfolio covering displays, streaming, smart speakers and third‑party accessories, with the new Siri AI as the connective core. Yet, across‑the‑board price increases, phased AI availability, delayed accessory shipments and iPhone dependence could all slow adoption.

Three key variables merit watching: first, whether consumers will pay a premium for higher integration after the simultaneous price hikes, especially given HomeView’s $299 price point versus cheaper rivals; second, the timing of full Siri AI availability on Apple TV 4K (beta) and HomePod mini 2, which will affect Apple’s market persuasion; third, whether HomeView’s reliance on iPhone and specific system conditions will limit its addressable market and delay rollout in regions like the EU that have not yet received the product.

If the new Siri can reliably handle more complex requests and HomeView can smoothly integrate locks, cameras, media devices and family calendars, the higher price may be justified by convenience and privacy advantages. Conversely, if consumers continue to view these devices mainly as media players, lighting controllers and basic voice‑command tools, the price hikes could become a barrier to market expansion. Apple’s smart‑home success will ultimately be validated by real‑world experience and willingness to pay after the first wave of products launches on November 13 and accessories arrive in December.

items.title: 美軍封鎖！伊朗海上原油出口「清零」美國達到多年制裁未能實現效果
items.title_en: U.S. Blockade! Iran’s Maritime Crude Oil Exports Reduced to Zero—U.S. Achieves What Years of Sanctions Could Not
paras: 美國對伊朗的封鎖直接切斷伊朗海運原油出口，能源情報機構Vortexa的數據顯示，伊朗原油海運出口自9月第二周降至零後，截至10月5日仍未恢復。
Vortexa的數據顯示，9月初伊朗原油海運出口的14日平均水準仍為每日23萬桶，隨後迅速降至零。
Vortexa海上風險與情報主管Claire Jungman表示，美國的封鎖在物理層面阻止了伊朗原油離開波斯灣，達到多年制裁未能實現的效果。
根據Vortexa的數據，伊朗滯留在海上油輪中的原油總量已降至約8,300萬桶，其中約4,300萬桶被困在荷姆茲海峽以西，受到美國封鎖影響，難以運出。
出口通道受阻不僅影響伊朗原油。Vortexa稱，伊朗液化石油氣出口9月較前月銳減48%，降至至少自2023年1月以來最少。這表明封鎖的影響已從原油延伸至其他能源產品。
不過，出口流量歸零不等於伊朗原油庫存已經消失。仍滯留在油輪上的數千萬噸級原油，意味著部分供應尚未進入國際市場，但未來伊朗能否重新裝運、通過何種渠道銷售，仍取決於封鎖持續時間及地區航運安全狀況。
paras_en: U.S. sanctions directly cut off Iran’s seaborne crude exports, and data from energy‑intelligence firm Vortexa show that after the export level fell to zero in the second week of September, it had not recovered as of Oct. 5.
Vortexa’s data indicate that in early September Iran’s 14‑day average seaborne crude shipments were still about 230,000 barrels per day, but then quickly dropped to zero.

Claire Jungman, Vortexa’s head of maritime risk and intelligence, said the U.S. blockade physically prevented Iranian crude from leaving the Persian Gulf, achieving an effect that years of sanctions had failed to produce.

According to Vortexa, the total amount of crude stranded on tankers at sea has fallen to roughly 83 million barrels, about 43 million of which are stuck west of the Hormuz Strait and are unable to move because of the U.S. blockade.

The blocked export route is affecting more than just crude. Vortexa reports that Iran’s liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) exports in September fell sharply by 48% from the previous month, reaching the lowest level since at least Jan. 2023, showing the blockade’s impact extending to other energy products.

However, zero export flow does not mean Iran’s crude inventories have vanished. Tens of millions of tonnes of oil still sit on tankers, meaning a portion of supply has not entered the global market, and whether Iran can reload and sell it later will depend on how long the blockade lasts and the safety of regional shipping routes.

items.title: 華爾街力挺AI變現能力！微軟股價創歷史、市值再突破4兆美元
items.title_en: Wall Street Backing AI Monetization: Microsoft Shares Hit Record High, Market Cap Surpasses $4 Trillion
paras: 微軟(Microsoft)(MSFT-US)股價周二(13日)收盤創歷史新高，市值則率先在周一重新站上4兆美元大關，為2025年10月以來首見。華爾街多家投資機構認為，微軟有望透過Azure雲端平台與Copilot人工智慧(AI)助理擴大營收，若龐大的AI投資真能帶來穩健回報，股價還有進一步上漲空間。
根據道瓊市場數據，微軟周二上漲0.4%，收在每股543.45美元，創下歷史新高，也是自2025年10月28日以來首度創下收盤新高。
微軟周一收盤上漲約1.2%至每股541.15美元，市值達4.02兆美元，為2025年10月以來首度突破4兆美元。

Azure與Copilot成AI變現關鍵

《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)報導，華爾街多家機構認為，微軟股價仍有上漲空間，看好該公司可望透過Azure雲端平台及AI助理Copilot進一步擴大營收。
微軟最近為Copilot推出新功能，可串連不同工具，讓企業在工作流程中建置、客製化及擴展AI應用，進一步提升市場對該公司AI變現潛力的期待。
微軟已大舉投資Azure與Copilot，2026會計年度第4季資本支出達410億美元，全年則達1450億美元。
華爾街預期，7月1日起的2027會計年度，AI支出將更高。不過，若這些投資能轉化為實質營收與獲利，龐大的AI支出仍可能為微軟股東帶來回報。

巴克萊上修目標價至600美元

巴克萊銀行(Barclays)周二檢視軟體類股財報前景後，將微軟目標價從512美元調高至600美元，並維持「加碼」評級。以微軟周一收盤價541.15美元計算，新目標價代表約11%的上漲空間。
整體而言，華爾街普遍看好微軟後市。根據FactSet調查的59家機構，微軟股票平均評級為「買進」，平均目標價為584.48美元。
摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)分析師Adam Wood周一也維持微軟「加碼」評級，目標價為600美元。他預測微軟的生成式AI支出意願仍將領先群雄，且「具備充分條件，能在涵蓋整個技術堆疊的多模型世界中實現商業化」。
Wood說：「微軟的策略機會，在於透過整個技術堆疊的多個環節，將企業AI工作流程轉化為營收，而不必過度依賴任何單一模型勝出。」

股價高於均線 投資人留意短線風險

但從技術面來看，儘管微軟股價創新高，但已也明顯高於重要移動平均線。以周二股價為例，與50日移動均線的502.90美元相比高出約8%，也較200日移動均線的434.20美元高出約26%。
《巴隆》指出，在股價持續走高、且與重要移動均線的距離進一步拉大的情況下，投資人可以考慮部分獲利了結，或先觀望股價還能再上漲的空間有多少。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) closed at a record high on Tuesday (13th), with its market capitalization reaching $4 trillion on Monday for the first time since October 2025. Several Wall Street firms believe Microsoft can expand revenue through its Azure cloud platform and Copilot AI assistant, and if the massive AI investment yields solid returns, the stock still has upside.
According to Dow Jones market data, Microsoft rose 0.4% on Tuesday, closing at $543.45 per share, a new record and the first closing high since October 28, 2025.
Microsoft closed up about 1.2% on Monday to $541.15 per share, with a market cap of $4.02 trillion, the first time it broke the $4 trillion threshold since October 2025.
Azure and Copilot are key to AI monetization.
Barron's reports that many Wall Street firms see further upside for Microsoft, expecting the company to grow revenue through Azure and the Copilot AI assistant.

Microsoft recently launched new Copilot features that link different tools, allowing enterprises to build, customize, and extend AI applications in their workflows, further boosting expectations of the company’s AI monetization potential.
Microsoft has invested heavily in Azure and Copilot, with capital expenditures of $41 billion in Q4 of fiscal 2026 and $145 billion for the full year.

Wall Street expects AI spending to rise even more in fiscal 2027 starting July 1. However, if these investments translate into real revenue and profits, the large AI spend could still reward Microsoft shareholders.
Overall, Wall Street is generally bullish on Microsoft’s future. A FactSet survey of 59 firms gave Microsoft an average rating of "Buy" and an average target price of $584.48.

Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Wood kept Microsoft’s "Add to Portfolio" rating on Monday, with a target price of $600. He predicts Microsoft’s willingness to spend on generative AI will remain ahead of peers and that it is "well positioned to commercialize in a multi‑model world covering the entire tech stack."
Wood said: "Microsoft’s strategic opportunity lies in converting enterprise AI workflows into revenue across multiple layers of the tech stack, without over‑relying on any single model to win."

From a technical perspective, although Microsoft’s stock has hit new highs, it is clearly above key moving averages. On Tuesday, the price was about 8% above the 50‑day moving average of $502.90 and about 26% above the 200‑day moving average of $434.20.
Barron's notes that as the price continues to rise and the gap to key moving averages widens, investors might consider taking partial profits or waiting to see how much further upside remains.

items.title: 先進模型爭霸！Gemini 4 Argon全面開放 Google用模型「操練」機器人
items.title_en: Advanced Model Showdown! Gemini 4 Argon Fully Opened; Google Uses Model to “Train” Robots
paras: Google(GOOGL-US)Gemini 4 Argon 10月13日開始面向全球開發者和企業開放。用戶可透過Gemini API、Google AI Studio、Google Antigravity等平台調用這一模型，符合條件的Gemini Pro和Ultra訂閱用戶也能在Gemini應用及搜尋中的AI模式體驗它。
與10月1日的有限開放相比，這次發佈更值得關注的，是Google披露的一系列實際應用：Argon不僅能重構大型軟體專案、最佳化模型推理，還能根據真實機器人操作影片建構模擬環境，並參與網路安全和科學研究。
Google試圖證明，先進模型的價值不只在於回答問題或生成程式碼，還在於能否接手複雜任務，將多個環節串聯起來，最終交付可以使用的結果。
Google首先拿自己的工程專案檢驗Argon。據Google披露，已有超過10萬名員工透過Antigravity內部版本使用該模型。過去四週，工程團隊的智慧代理程式碼提交量增加35%，提交後的程式碼回滾減少近三分之一。
Chrome團隊的重構專案更能說明問題。Chromium程式碼庫約有4,000萬行，其中一個約600萬行的遺留程式碼目錄，長期混雜著多種瀏覽器功能，與核心網頁處理邏輯交織在一起。Argon幫助團隊將核心功能從遺留程式碼中剝離，完成涉及數百個檔案的架構重構，將原本需要數月的工作壓縮到幾週。
Google開源的Agent Development Kit（ADK）團隊也進行了類似嘗試。團隊向Argon提供規則手冊和最佳化目標，要求它在不破壞現有應用的前提下減少框架開銷。經過一夜運行，模型提出的改動使長會話的記憶體準備時間減少40%，冷啟動匯入速度提高21%，相關程式碼已合併至公開的ADK Python程式碼庫。
在底層模型最佳化方面，Argon將Gemma 4 E2B在單張NVIDIA A100上的推理吞吐量，從每秒約3.79萬個token提高到超過10.8萬個，提升約2.85倍。Google稱，最佳化後的輸出保持一致，整個過程僅用幾天，涉及注意力調校和推測解碼等環節。
這些案例來自Google自身，它們共同指向一個變化：模型開始參與從程式碼理解、架構調整到效能最佳化和問題排查的完整工程流程，而不只是按照指令生成程式碼。
Argon的視覺理解和生成能力也延伸到了3D建模。Google展示的案例中，Gemini 4 Argon透過Antigravity中的多代理視覺批判循環，在Blender中自主建構了一組高度精細的寺廟建築群，包括多座建築、植被和複雜光照，呈現出接近照片的視覺效果。
從真實機器人到科學研究
大型程式碼庫檢驗的是Argon處理複雜軟體系統的能力，機器人專案則考驗模型能否理解真實世界中的空間關係和物理互動，並將這種理解轉化為可執行的程式。
Google展示的Real2Sim專案，正是圍繞這問題展開。Argon可以觀看真實機器人遙操作影片，建構對應的數位孿生環境，並取得或生成模擬資產，使物體不僅外觀接近真實物件，在與靈巧機械手接觸時也能呈現相似的物理行為。隨後，模型透過反覆視覺推理調整物體屬性和場景設定，讓模擬中的視覺效果與接觸過程盡可能貼近真實紀錄。
這項流程的意義在於，機器人訓練不必完全依賴人工從頭搭建模擬環境。真實操作影片可以成為建模的起點，模型再根據模擬與現實之間的差異，不斷修正場景。
另一項展示則從一張草圖開始。Argon根據人形機器人向桌上的箱子堆扔球的示意圖，自動生成GPU加速的模擬場景和全身動作軌跡，並在物理引擎中驗證六個箱子全部倒下，最終輸出渲染影片。不過，模擬成功並不等於機器人已經具備穩定的現實操作能力。物理環境、感測器誤差和致動器限制，都可能影響動作遷移效果。
Google還將Argon用於網路安全和科學研究。在網路安全領域，Google透過Fairwind計畫向更多合作夥伴開放模型，用於經過授權的防禦性安全工作。
在科學研究中，Argon參與了量子運算、核融合和生命科學專案。Google稱，模型將內部量子錯誤更正解碼器轉換為最佳化的硬體核心，使推理吞吐量接近翻倍；在與馬里蘭大學研究人員的合作中，它幫助發現更多Grad猜想的反例，為核融合反應爐磁場設計提供新的研究依據。
生命科學方面，Gamow Labs的研究人員使用Argon分析罕見發育性肺部疾病新生兒的基因組，在一個病例中發現常規軟體多年未能識別的染色體重排，並解釋了此前漏檢的原因。
這些專案的共同點，是模型需要理解專業資料、生成解決方案，再根據運算或實驗結果進行調整。Google正在嘗試將這種能力從軟體工程延伸到具有不同規則和驗證方式的專業領域。
模型之外 還要補上工具鏈
Argon能否進入企業工作流程，不只取決於模型表現，還取決於使用成本、工具配套和任務完成效率。
Google給出的限時API價格為每百萬輸入token 2美元、輸出10美元，快取輸入為0.1美元。12月1日起，輸入和輸出價格將分別提高至4美元和20美元。
Argon還提供100萬token的統一上下文視窗，輸入、思考和輸出共用這一額度。
API支援背景執行和檢查點恢復，適用於多儲存庫遷移、複雜程式碼分析等需要長時間執行的任務。
基準測試顯示，Argon在部分專業任務中具有競爭力。在Vals Index上，它獲得68.9%的成績，高於Claude Sonnet 5.5的67.04%和Opus 5.5的66.97%。
Google公布的測試中，Argon在Harvey法律代理基準上得分19.6%，在Zapier自動化基準上得分51.3%，在DeepSWE軟體工程基準上得分77.9%。
但在Artificial Analysis綜合智慧指數中，Argon獲得53分，與GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1持平，低於Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5和Meta Muse Wonder Full。
沃頓商學院教授Ethan Mollick認為，Gemini 4在創意和寫作方面取得顯著進步，為現有先進模型提供了不同的選擇。不過，他指出，模型處理複雜多智慧代理任務時仍有不足，有時過於自信，Antigravity的工具鏈也需要改進。
企業AI諮詢公司Red Dragon AI的Sam Witteveen認為，Argon是一個非常出色但並非最強的模型。他看好模型結合視覺理解、軟體生成和創意媒體的能力，但認為Antigravity與Claude Code、Codex等開發工具相比仍有差距。
Argon的全面開放，讓更多開發者和企業有機會檢驗Google展示的能力。但從模型能夠完成某項任務，到企業可以穩定、低成本地將其投入生產，中間仍有一段距離。
Vercel執行長Guillermo Rauch認為，Google擁有Transformer技術積累、工程人才和運算資源，不應被低估。
對Google而言，接下來要解決的不只是繼續提升模型能力，還包括讓模型更容易使用、讓複雜任務運行得更穩定，並讓實際成本與效率優勢真正經得起檢驗。
paras_en: Google (GOOGL-US) announced that Gemini 4 Argon will be open to developers and enterprises worldwide starting October 13. Users can access the model via Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity and other platforms, and eligible Gemini Pro and Ultra subscribers can also experience it in Gemini apps and the AI mode of Search.

Compared with the limited release on October 1, this announcement is notable for the range of real‑world applications Google disclosed: Argon can refactor large software projects, optimise model inference, build simulated environments from real robot‑operation videos, and take part in cybersecurity and scientific research.

Google is trying to prove that the value of advanced models lies not only in answering questions or generating code, but also in handling complex tasks, linking multiple steps together, and ultimately delivering usable results.

Google first tested Argon on its own engineering projects. According to Google, more than 100,000 employees have used the internal Antigravity version of the model. Over the past four weeks, the engineering team’s smart‑agent code‑submission volume rose 35%, while code rollbacks after submission fell by nearly one‑third.

The Chrome team’s refactoring project illustrates the point even better. The Chromium codebase is about 40 million lines, including a legacy segment of roughly 6 million lines that mixes many browser functions with core web‑processing logic. Argon helped the team strip core functionality out of the legacy code, completing an architecture refactor involving hundreds of files and compressing work that would have taken months into a few weeks.

Google’s open‑source Agent Development Kit (ADK) team made a similar attempt. The team fed Argon a rulebook and optimisation targets, asking it to reduce framework overhead without breaking existing applications. After an overnight run, the model’s suggested changes cut long‑session memory‑preparation time by 40% and improved cold‑start import speed by 21%; the related code has been merged into the public ADK Python repository.

On the low‑level model optimisation side, Argon boosted Gemma 4 E2B’s inference throughput on a single NVIDIA A100 from about 37,900 tokens per second to over 108,000 tokens – an increase of roughly 2.85×. Google says the optimised output remains consistent, and the whole process took only a few days, involving attention tuning and speculative decoding among other steps.

These cases come from Google itself and together point to a shift: models are now participating in the full engineering workflow—from code understanding and architectural adjustments to performance optimisation and debugging—rather than merely generating code on command.

Argon’s visual understanding and generation abilities also extend to 3D modelling. In a demo, Gemini 4 Argon used Antigravity’s multi‑agent visual critique loop to autonomously build a highly detailed temple complex in Blender, complete with multiple structures, vegetation and complex lighting, achieving near‑photorealistic visual quality.
From Real Robots to Scientific Research

Large code‑base tests assess Argon’s ability to handle complex software systems, while the robot project tests whether the model can grasp spatial relationships and physical interactions in the real world and translate that understanding into executable programs.

Google’s Real2Sim project tackles exactly this challenge. Argon watches real‑world robot tele‑operation videos, constructs a corresponding digital twin environment, and acquires or generates simulation assets so that objects not only look like their real counterparts but also exhibit similar physical behaviour when touched by a dexterous robotic hand. The model then iteratively refines object properties and scene settings through visual reasoning, making the simulated visuals and contact processes as close as possible to the real recordings.

The significance of this workflow is that robot training no longer has to rely entirely on manually built simulation environments. Real‑world operation videos can serve as the starting point, with the model continuously correcting the scene based on differences between simulation and reality.

Another demo starts from a single sketch. Given a diagram of a humanoid robot throwing balls at a stack of boxes on a table, Argon automatically generates a GPU‑accelerated simulation scene and full‑body motion trajectories, and verifies in the physics engine that all six boxes topple, finally outputting a rendered video. However, a successful simulation does not mean the robot has stable real‑world capability; physical environments, sensor errors and actuator limits can all affect motion transfer.
Google also applied Argon to cybersecurity and scientific research. In cybersecurity, Google is opening the model to more partners through the Fairwind program for authorised defensive security work.

In scientific research, Argon has been involved in quantum computing, nuclear fusion and life‑science projects. Google says the model turned an internal quantum error‑correction decoder into an optimised hardware core, nearly doubling inference throughput; in collaboration with researchers at the University of Maryland, it helped discover additional counter‑examples to the Grad conjecture, providing new insights for magnetic‑field design in fusion reactors.

In life sciences, researchers at Gamow Labs used Argon to analyse the genome of a newborn with a rare developmental lung disease and identified a chromosomal rearrangement that conventional software had missed for years, explaining why it had previously gone undetected.

These projects share a common thread: the model must understand specialised data, generate solutions, and then adjust them based on computational or experimental results. Google is trying to extend this capability from software engineering to professional domains with different rules and validation methods.
Beyond the Model, the Toolchain Is Needed
Whether Argon can enter enterprise workflows depends not only on model performance but also on usage cost, tooling support and task‑completion efficiency.

Google’s limited‑time API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.1. Starting December 1, input and output prices will rise to $4 and $20 respectively.
Argon also offers a unified context window of 1 million tokens shared among input, reasoning and output.
The API supports background execution and checkpoint recovery, suitable for long‑running tasks such as multi‑repo migrations and complex code analysis.
Benchmark tests show Argon is competitive on certain professional tasks. On the Vals Index it scored 68.9%, ahead of Claude Sonnet 5.5’s 67.04% and Opus 5.5’s 66.97%.
In Google’s own tests, Argon scored 19.6% on the Harvey legal‑assistant benchmark, 51.3% on the Zapier automation benchmark, and 77.9% on the DeepSWE software‑engineering benchmark.

However, on the Artificial Analysis comprehensive intelligence index, Argon received a score of 53, matching GPT‑6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, but lagging behind Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Meta Muse Wonder Full.

Wharton professor Ethan Mollick says Gemini 4 shows significant progress in creativity and writing, offering a different option among advanced models. He notes, however, that the model still falls short on complex multi‑agent tasks, can be over‑confident, and that Antigravity’s toolchain needs improvement.

Red Dragon AI consultant Sam Witteveen calls Argon a very strong but not the strongest model. He is optimistic about its combination of visual understanding, software generation and creative media, but believes Antigravity still lags behind development tools like Claude Code and Codex.

Argon’s full opening gives more developers and companies the chance to test the capabilities Google showcased. Yet there remains a gap between a model being able to complete a task and an enterprise being able to deploy it stably and cost‑effectively at scale.
Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch believes Google’s accumulated Transformer expertise, engineering talent and compute resources should not be underestimated.

For Google, the next challenges are not only to keep improving model capability but also to make the model easier to use, ensure complex tasks run more reliably, and prove that the real‑world cost and efficiency advantages truly hold up.

paras: 台股近日不但5萬點沒站上，指數反而從高檔急速下殺，許多投資人的第一個念頭，恐怕不是要買什麼，而是：「是不是該趕快逃命？」
這時候散戶最容易犯的錯，就是把股價下跌直接等同於基本面轉壞。股票漲多了，確實需要整理；然而，整理不代表行情一定結束，真正值得注意的，是這一波下跌究竟只是短線籌碼鬆動，還是企業獲利成長的趨勢也跟著改變。

上週台股衝上歷史新高時，市場的短線技術指標與主力成本 K 值已經衝到 95 以上的嚴重過熱區。但偏偏這段時間「融資餘額」不減反增，一堆散戶開著高槓桿想進場搶短賺快錢。
主力的字典裡最討厭「不勞而獲的散戶」。他們最喜歡用的狠招，就是趁著市場指標過熱時「狠狠甩轎」，用極端劇烈的震盪把這群追高的融資散戶「洗到脫皮」！當散戶嚇得慌忙砍倉、交出手中血淚籌碼時，八大公股與四大退休基金正默默在低檔大舉護盤加碼，外資機構更是接連上修台股目標價，將企業獲利展望再度調高。
再把目光放回國際，美股的輝達(NVDA-US)以及全球 CSP 雲端大廠的 AI 資本支出持續爆衝，台灣作為全球半導體與 AI 供應鏈的核心，基本面根本一絲一毫都沒有壞！正如我常說的金句：「噴出是風險，大跌才是機會！」 追高容易受傷，但大跌時看懂結構的人，才能拿到下一波主升段的黃金門票。
拉回該買什麼？看懂「營收創高＋法人買」的黃金密碼
既然大跌是機會，那是不是隨便閉著眼睛亂買？絕對不行！每一次大甩轎，都是市場重新檢視股票體質的殘酷試金石。那些沒有基本面支撐、只靠題材炒作的「空殼股」，一旦跟著回檔往往直接現出原形，跌下去就再也回不來了。
這時候的選股邏輯只有一個，那就是精準鎖定：「9 月營收創歷史新高」加上「法人逆勢大買」的指標強勢股！營收創高代表公司在實體經濟裡業績有真本領、有訂單在手；而法人在急殺震盪中還敢掏真金白銀逆勢加碼，代表大戶早就看好它未來的爆發力。
7檔營收成長指標股：基本面利多一次看

paras_en: Taiwan stocks recently not only failed to break the 50,000-point mark, the index instead plunged sharply from its highs, and many investors' first thought is probably not what to buy, but “Should I get out quickly?”

At this moment, the most common mistake retail investors make is equating a price drop with a deterioration in fundamentals. A stock that has risen a lot does need a correction; however, a correction does not mean the rally is over. What truly matters is whether this decline is merely a short‑term shake‑out of capital or if the companies' profit growth trends are also changing.
The truth behind the crash: the main players’ “margin‑call shake‑out” tactic

Last week, when Taiwan stocks surged to a historic high, short‑term technical indicators and the main players’ cost‑basis K‑value had already surged above 95, a severe overheat zone. Yet during that period the “margin balance” did not decrease but actually increased, as many retail investors with high leverage tried to jump in for quick gains.

In the main players’ dictionary, the most despised group is “idle retail investors.” Their favorite ruthless move is to “dump the cart” hard when market indicators are overheated, using extreme volatility to “wash” these high‑flying margin‑trading retail investors to the point of skin‑splitting! As retail investors panic‑sell and hand over their blood‑stained shares, the eight major state‑owned firms and four large pension funds quietly step in to support the market at low levels, while foreign institutional investors repeatedly raise their Taiwan stock target prices, upgrading corporate earnings outlooks again.

Turning to the global scene, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and the world’s major CSP cloud providers continue to explode their AI capital expenditures. Taiwan, as the core of the global semiconductor and AI supply chain, has fundamentals that are not a single iota weak! As I often say, “Sprays are risk, crashes are opportunity!” Buying on the rally is easy to get hurt, but only those who understand the structure during a crash can grab the golden ticket to the next major up‑trend.
What should you buy now? Understanding the golden code of “record‑high revenue + institutional buying”

Since a crash is an opportunity, does that mean you can just buy blindly with your eyes closed? Absolutely not! Every massive “cart dump” is a brutal test that the market uses to re‑examine a stock’s health. Those “shell stocks” that lack fundamental support and rely only on hype will usually reveal their true form during the pull‑back and never recover.

At this point the stock‑picking logic is simple: precisely target stocks that show “September revenue at a historic high” combined with “institutional investors buying heavily against the trend.” Record‑high revenue indicates the company has real performance and orders in the real economy; institutional buying during a sharp sell‑off shows that big players already see strong future explosive potential.
Seven revenue‑growth indicator stocks: a quick look at fundamental upside

Wistron (4938‑TW): September revenue rose 143% month‑over‑month and 86.9% year‑over‑year, and the stock was heavily bought by institutions this week. As a leader in electronics manufacturing and consumer products, it benefits from the autumn new‑product stocking wave and a surge in AI server shipments, driving strong operational momentum.

MiTAC (3706‑TW): September revenue rose 39.5% month‑over‑month and 88.6% year‑over‑year, with strong institutional buying. Deeply rooted in server and automotive electronics niches, it enjoys explosive growth as cloud data‑center and AI server demand continues to surge.

WPG Holdings (3702‑TW): September revenue rose 54.4% month‑over‑month and 146% year‑over‑year, with strong institutional buying. As the global semiconductor distribution leader, it benefits from the AI chip pull‑forward and semiconductor recovery, delivering double‑digit growth and a very solid profit moat.

Chang Ke (6548‑TW)*: September revenue rose 3.8% month‑over‑month and 42.9% year‑over‑year, with institutions continuously adding on the dip. A major supplier of lead‑frame packaging materials, it is actively expanding into automotive and high‑end semiconductor packaging, offering strong profit‑growth potential under packaging‑technology upgrades.

Wan Run (6187‑TW): September revenue rose 4.64% month‑over‑month and 109% year‑over‑year, highly favored by institutions. As a core CoWoS advanced packaging equipment maker, it is tightly linked to TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain; AI‑chip demand explosion pushes revenue up more than double year‑over‑year, with a bright long‑term outlook.

Creative (3443‑TW): September revenue rose 22.3% month‑over‑month and 97.8% year‑over‑year, with steady institutional positioning. A leader in ASIC custom chip design under TSMC, it rides the wave of Nvidia and global CSP cloud providers’ in‑house chip development, driving strong profit gains from high‑end design demand.

Tian Er Technology (6834‑TW): September revenue rose 6.74% month‑over‑month and a staggering 132% year‑over‑year, with institutions buying heavily against the trend. As a major passive component (resistor) manufacturer, it benefits from the restart of a price‑rise cycle in passive components and strong AI server high‑end power‑supply orders, delivering double‑digit explosive growth and powerful profit momentum.

items.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon全球上線 推廣價截至11月底
items.title_en: Google Gemini 4 Argon Global Launch with Promotional Pricing Until End of November
paras: Google將旗艦AI模型Gemini 4 Argon推向全球用戶，在此前近三周僅向網路安全防禦合作夥伴開放後，這款模型周二（13日）正式擴大開放，向普通用戶、開發者和企業提供服務。
Google宣布，Gemini 4 Argon全球上線。Google AI Pro和Ultra訂閱用戶可以在Gemini應用及Google搜索AI模式（AI Mode）中體驗該模型。開發者和企業用戶可通過付費版Gemini API調用。
Ultra訂閱用戶還可在Google AI Studio和Antigravity中使用該模型，企業用戶則可通過Gemini企業服務及Antigravity接入。
Google DeepMind表示，Argon旨在從頭到尾解決複雜問題，在編程、企業工作流和網路安全防禦方面提供先進能力。
Google AI Studio產品負責人Logan Kilpatrick說，該模型過去一個月已在內部經過超過10萬人測試，研發團隊為此次發表投入了大約六個月的時間。
價格是Argon爭奪開發者和企業客戶的另一項重要籌碼。
Google為面向公眾開放的Argon設置了限時推廣價格，至2026年11月30日止，每百萬輸入Token收費2美元，每百萬輸出Token收費10美元。推廣期結束後，價格將分別漲至4美元和20美元，輸入、輸出價格均翻倍。
緩存輸入Token的價格折扣則達到95%。按推廣期輸入價格計算，命中緩存的輸入Token成本約每百萬0.10美元；調價後約每百萬0.20美元。
對需要反覆調用相同背景材料、處理長上下文或執行多輪任務的應用而言，緩存機制有望降低部分使用成本。
GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1的輸入、輸出Token價格分別為每百萬10美元和50美元，均為Argon推廣期價格的五倍。Claude Opus 5.5的對應價格為4美元和20美元，與Argon推廣期結束後的定價相當。
總體來看，Google此次發表釋出兩項信號：一方面，Gemini 4 Argon開始從網路安全領域的有限測試走向更廣泛商業應用；另一方面，Google試圖通過長上下文、複雜任務執行能力和有競爭力的初期定價，吸引開發者將其納入實際工作流程。
paras_en: Google is rolling out its flagship AI model Gemini 4 Argon to users worldwide, expanding from a three‑week limited release to cybersecurity partners to a full launch on Tuesday (the 13th) for regular users, developers, and enterprises.

Google announced that Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available. Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers can experience the model in the Gemini app and Google Search’s AI Mode. Developers and enterprise customers can access it via the paid Gemini API.
Ultra subscribers can also use the model in Google AI Studio and Antigravity, while enterprise customers can access it through Gemini Enterprise Services and Antigravity.
Google DeepMind said Argon is designed to solve complex problems end‑to‑end, offering advanced capabilities in programming, enterprise workflows, and cybersecurity defense.

Logan Kilpatrick, product lead for Google AI Studio, said the model has been tested internally by more than 100,000 people over the past month, and the development team spent roughly six months preparing for this release.
Pricing is another key lever for Argon to win over developers and enterprise clients.

Google has set a limited‑time promotional price for the publicly available Argon until November 30, 2026: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. After the promo ends, prices will double to $4 and $20 per million respectively.
The discount for cached input tokens reaches 95%. At the promotional input rate, cached input tokens cost about $0.10 per million; after the price increase, about $0.20 per million.
For applications that repeatedly call the same background material, handle long contexts, or perform multi‑turn tasks, the caching mechanism is expected to reduce some usage costs.

The input and output token prices for GPT‑6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 are $10 and $50 per million respectively, five times the Argon promotional rates. Claude Opus 5.5’s prices are $4 and $20 per million, matching Argon’s post‑promo pricing.

Overall, Google’s announcement sends two signals: Gemini 4 Argon is moving from limited cybersecurity testing to broader commercial use, and Google is trying to attract developers into real‑world workflows with long‑context, complex‑task capabilities and competitive early pricing.

items.title: 納坦雅胡傳遊說川普「選舉前」重啟對伊朗戰爭！美以軍方高度戒備、川普態度反覆
items.title_en: Netanyahu Said He Urged Trump to "Reopen" War Against Iran Before Election; US and Israeli Militaries on High Alert, Trump’s Stance Fluctuates
paras: 以色列與伊朗戰事是否可能再度升溫，引發外界關注。根據以色列第12頻道電視台週二（13日）報導，以色列總理納坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）上週與美國總統川普通話，討論在美國11月初國會期中選舉前，甚至以色列10月27日國會選舉前，重啟對伊朗軍事行動的可能性。
報導引述一名美方知情官員指出，納坦雅胡似乎希望在選舉前對伊朗發動攻擊。不過，川普先前已公開表示，不會在美國期中選舉前打擊伊朗。
儘管如此，報導引述匿名消息人士說法指出，以色列國防軍與美軍中央司令部目前均處於「高度戒備狀態」，並持續完成相關準備，以防川普「改變主意」。
對於相關報導，納坦雅胡辦公室予以否認，強調納坦雅胡並未敦促川普在選舉前攻擊伊朗，並表示他持續與川普及美國政府高階官員保持對話。
然而，根據報導引述的一名美國消息人士說法，納坦雅胡與川普曾「多次」討論恢復對伊朗軍事打擊的可能性。川普曾告訴納坦雅胡可以著手準備，但並未正式承諾批准攻擊行動。
一名以色列高階官員則透露，川普最初似乎傾向批准相關行動，但隨後又改變立場。報導指出，美國對於是否重啟對伊朗軍事打擊的態度持續變動，立場幾乎每隔幾天就會出現變化。
paras_en: Israel’s possible escalation of conflict with Iran has drawn outside attention. According to Israel’s Channel 12 TV report on Tuesday the 13th, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke with U.S. President Donald Trump last week, discussing the possibility of restarting military action against Iran before the U.S. mid‑term elections in early November and even before Israel’s own parliamentary election on October 27.

The report quoted a U.S. official familiar with the matter as saying Netanyahu appears to want to launch an attack on Iran before the election. However, Trump has previously stated publicly that he will not strike Iran before the U.S. mid‑terms.

Nevertheless, the report cited an anonymous source who said the Israel Defense Forces and the U.S. Central Command are both on “high alert” and are continuing to complete related preparations in case Trump “changes his mind.”
Netanyahu’s office denied the reports, stressing that he did not urge Trump to attack Iran before the election and that he continues to hold talks with Trump and senior U.S. officials.

However, according to a U.S. source quoted in the report, Netanyahu and Trump have discussed the possibility of resuming military strikes on Iran “many times.” Trump told Netanyahu that preparations could begin, but he did not formally commit to approving an attack.

An Israeli senior official disclosed that Trump initially seemed inclined to approve the action but later changed his stance. The report noted that the United States’ position on whether to restart military strikes against Iran keeps shifting, with the stance changing almost every few days.

items.title_en: One Purchase for 20 Years! Trump Says Taiwan Will Secure 30% of Alaska LNG Output and Add $4.4 Billion Investment
paras: 美國總統川普表示，台灣已同意在未來20年內，採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣（LNG）管線計畫30%的天然氣產量，並在期中選舉前大力宣傳這項計畫。
川普還表示，台灣將額外投資44億美元，協助該計畫完工。他周二(13日)在阿拉斯加州的競選活動中讚揚這些承諾，並宣稱雖然外界對管道能否建成仍存疑，但此舉已「確保了計畫的成功」。
台灣方面尚未立即證實川普的說法。
川普本月初曾表示，南韓將投資540億美元建設阿拉斯加LNG合資計畫，用於輸送阿拉斯加北坡（North Slope）的天然氣並將其液化出口。然而，南韓方面表示，僅會在該計畫具備商業可行性的前提下才會推進。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of the natural‑gas output from the Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) pipeline project over the next 20 years, and he will heavily promote the plan before the mid‑term elections.

Trump also said Taiwan will invest an additional $4.4 billion to help complete the project. He praised the commitments during a campaign event in Alaska on Tuesday the 13th, claiming that, although doubts remain about whether the pipeline can be built, the move has "guaranteed the project's success."
Taiwan has not immediately confirmed Trump's statements.

Earlier this month, Trump claimed South Korea would invest $54 billion in a joint Alaska LNG venture to transport natural gas from the North Slope and liquefy it for export. South Korean officials, however, said they would only proceed if the project proved commercially viable.

paras_en: Taiwan stocks recently not only failed to break the 50,000-point mark, the index instead plunged sharply from its highs, and many investors' first thought is probably not what to buy, but “Should I get out quickly?”

At this moment, the most common mistake retail investors make is equating a price drop with a deterioration in fundamentals. A stock that has risen a lot does need a correction; however, a correction does not mean the rally is over. What truly matters is whether this decline is merely a short‑term shake‑out of capital or if the companies' profit growth trends are also changing.
The truth behind the crash: the main players’ “margin‑call shake‑out” tactic

Last week, when Taiwan stocks surged to a historic high, short‑term technical indicators and the main players’ cost‑basis K‑value had already surged above 95, a severe overheat zone. Yet during that period the “margin balance” did not decrease but actually increased, as many retail investors with high leverage tried to jump in for quick gains.

In the main players’ dictionary, the most despised group is “idle retail investors.” Their favorite ruthless move is to “dump the cart” hard when market indicators are overheated, using extreme volatility to “wash” these high‑flying margin‑trading retail investors to the point of skin‑splitting! As retail investors panic‑sell and hand over their blood‑stained shares, the eight major state‑owned firms and four large pension funds quietly step in to support the market at low levels, while foreign institutional investors repeatedly raise their Taiwan stock target prices, upgrading corporate earnings outlooks again.

Turning to the global scene, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and the world’s major CSP cloud providers continue to explode their AI capital expenditures. Taiwan, as the core of the global semiconductor and AI supply chain, has fundamentals that are not a single iota weak! As I often say, “Sprays are risk, crashes are opportunity!” Buying on the rally is easy to get hurt, but only those who understand the structure during a crash can grab the golden ticket to the next major up‑trend.
What should you buy now? Understanding the golden code of “record‑high revenue + institutional buying”

Since a crash is an opportunity, does that mean you can just buy blindly with your eyes closed? Absolutely not! Every massive “cart dump” is a brutal test that the market uses to re‑examine a stock’s health. Those “shell stocks” that lack fundamental support and rely only on hype will usually reveal their true form during the pull‑back and never recover.

At this point the stock‑picking logic is simple: precisely target stocks that show “September revenue at a historic high” combined with “institutional investors buying heavily against the trend.” Record‑high revenue indicates the company has real performance and orders in the real economy; institutional buying during a sharp sell‑off shows that big players already see strong future explosive potential.
Seven revenue‑growth indicator stocks: a quick look at fundamental upside

Wistron (4938‑TW): September revenue rose 143% month‑over‑month and 86.9% year‑over‑year, and the stock was heavily bought by institutions this week. As a leader in electronics manufacturing and consumer products, it benefits from the autumn new‑product stocking wave and a surge in AI server shipments, driving strong operational momentum.

MiTAC (3706‑TW): September revenue rose 39.5% month‑over‑month and 88.6% year‑over‑year, with strong institutional buying. Deeply rooted in server and automotive electronics niches, it enjoys explosive growth as cloud data‑center and AI server demand continues to surge.

WPG Holdings (3702‑TW): September revenue rose 54.4% month‑over‑month and 146% year‑over‑year, with strong institutional buying. As the global semiconductor distribution leader, it benefits from the AI chip pull‑forward and semiconductor recovery, delivering double‑digit growth and a very solid profit moat.

Chang Ke (6548‑TW)*: September revenue rose 3.8% month‑over‑month and 42.9% year‑over‑year, with institutions continuously adding on the dip. A major supplier of lead‑frame packaging materials, it is actively expanding into automotive and high‑end semiconductor packaging, offering strong profit‑growth potential under packaging‑technology upgrades.

Wan Run (6187‑TW): September revenue rose 4.64% month‑over‑month and 109% year‑over‑year, highly favored by institutions. As a core CoWoS advanced packaging equipment maker, it is tightly linked to TSMC’s (2330‑TW) supply chain; AI‑chip demand explosion pushes revenue up more than double year‑over‑year, with a bright long‑term outlook.

Creative (3443‑TW): September revenue rose 22.3% month‑over‑month and 97.8% year‑over‑year, with steady institutional positioning. A leader in ASIC custom chip design under TSMC, it rides the wave of Nvidia and global CSP cloud providers’ in‑house chip development, driving strong profit gains from high‑end design demand.

Tian Er Technology (6834‑TW): September revenue rose 6.74% month‑over‑month and a staggering 132% year‑over‑year, with institutions buying heavily against the trend. As a major passive component (resistor) manufacturer, it benefits from the restart of a price‑rise cycle in passive components and strong AI server high‑end power‑supply orders, delivering double‑digit explosive growth and powerful profit momentum.
